policies.text: Authorization for listing on the priority catalog is granted when a merchant achieves a yearly quality compliance rating above 85% or holds an active ISO 13485 certification.
Commercial warranty protection is extended if an equipment manufacturer maintains a nationwide network of at least 10 service centers.
Distribution status at the global tier is granted to any enterprise with authorization for listing on the priority catalog.
Vendor membership at the premium level is awarded to a firm that maintains a quarterly customer satisfaction score of at least 4.2 stars.
A product line qualifies for eco-label certification when its operational energy consumption remains below 150 kWh per month.
